# Famille 

## Tout le monde

```{r Import}

### 1.1.1 Importer la base
fam_id_0 <- haven::read_sas("../../data_hors_git/raw_data/gb_ddb_id_01_fa_04.sas7bdat")
```

### Reduire le nb de variables

```{r M4_L0 to M4_L1}
### 1.1.2 Identifier les colonnes vides
empty_cols_fam_id <- fam_id_0 %>%
  mutate(across(
    .cols = where(is.character),
    .fns = ~ na_if(., "")
  )) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.)))) %>% 
  pivot_longer(everything(),
               names_to = "variable",
               values_to = "nb_empty_cells") %>% 
  filter(nb_empty_cells == nrow(fam_id_0))

### 1.1.3 Créer vecteur avec le nom des variables à retirer
vars_vides <- empty_cols_fam_id$variable

### 1.1.4 Retirer les variables, corriger les formats et les NA character
fam_id_1 <- fam_id_0 %>%
  select(-all_of(vars_vides)) %>% 
  haven::zap_label() %>% 
  haven::zap_formats() %>%
  mutate(across(
    .cols = where(is.character),
    .fns = ~ na_if(., "")
  )) %>%  
  select(-c("tab_db",
            "fa_type")) %>% 
  select(-starts_with("id_"), id_anonymat, id_sep, id_date_nais, id_date_creation, id_sexe) %>% 
  relocate(fa_date_creation, id_date_creation, id_anonymat, id_sep, id_date_nais, id_sexe)


rm(list = c("empty_cols_fam_id", "vars_vides", "fam_id_0"))
```


### Corriger données d'identité manquantes

```{r}

fam_id_2 <- fam_id_1 %>% 
  rows_patch(
    identite_dbl %>% 
      select(any_of(colnames(fam_id_1))),
    by = "id_anonymat",
    unmatched = "ignore"
  ) %>% 
  left_join(
    identite_dbl %>% 
      select(id_anonymat, id_doublon, id_keep),
    by = "id_anonymat"
  ) %>% 
  relocate(c("id_doublon", "id_keep"), .after = id_anonymat)

# Isoler les doublons

doublons <- fam_id_2 %>% 
  group_by(id_keep) %>% 
  filter(any(id_anonymat %in% identite_dbl$id_doublon)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(
    absent = if_all(fo_conjt_prof:sf_matrimoniale, is.na),
    .after = id_sexe
  ) %>% 
  filter(!absent) %>% 
  select(-id_anonymat, id_anonymat = id_keep, -id_sep, -absent) %>% 
  relocate(id_anonymat, .before = id_doublon)

fam_id_3 <- bind_rows(
  fam_id_2 %>% 
    filter_out(id_doublon %in% doublons$id_doublon) %>% 
    select(-id_keep, -id_sep),
  doublons
)



```

### Corriger les doublons

```{r M4_L1 to M4_L2}

fam_id_2 <- fam_id_1 %>% 
  group_by(id_anonymat) %>% 
  mutate(n = n(),
         .after = id_module) %>% 
  relocate(fo_revenus_corr, .after = id_module) %>%
  relocate(id_sexe, .after = id_module) %>%
  arrange(n, id_anonymat) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter_out(n == 2 & is.na(id_module)) %>% 
  select(-n, -id_sep) %>%
  rows_patch(
    M1_F2 %>% 
      select(id_anonymat, id_date_nais, id_sexe),
    by = "id_anonymat"
  )

# write_csv(M4_L2, "../../data_hors_git/clean_data/aut26/thoa_M4_L2.csv")

```

## Que participants

```{r}

fam_0 <- haven::read_sas("../../data_hors_git/raw_data/gb_ddb_famille_04.sas7bdat")

```

### reduire nb de variables

```{r }
### 1.1.2 Identifier les colonnes vides
empty_cols_fam_0 <- fam_0 %>%
  mutate(across(
    .cols = where(is.character),
    .fns = ~ na_if(., "")
  )) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.)))) %>% 
  pivot_longer(everything(),
               names_to = "variable",
               values_to = "nb_empty_cells") %>% 
  filter(nb_empty_cells == nrow(fam_0))

### 1.1.3 Créer vecteur avec le nom des variables à retirer
vars_vides <- empty_cols_fam_0$variable

### 1.1.4 Retirer les variables, corriger les formats et les NA character
fam_1 <- fam_0 %>%
  select(-all_of(vars_vides)) %>% 
  haven::zap_label() %>% 
  haven::zap_formats() %>%
  mutate(across(
    .cols = where(is.character),
    .fns = ~ na_if(., "")
  )) %>%  
  select(-c("tab_db",
            "fa_type")) %>% 
  relocate(fa_date_creation, id_anonymat, id_sep, id_date_nais) %>% 
  mutate(
    id_anonymat = replace_when(
      id_anonymat,
      id_anonymat %in% M1_F2$id_module ~ str_sub(id_sep, 7, 11)
    )
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    id_module = case_when(
      str_sub(id_sep, 7, 11) == id_anonymat ~ str_sub(id_sep, 1, 5)
    ),
    .after = id_sep
  )

rm(list = c("empty_cols_fam_0", "vars_vides", "fam_0"))
```
